name: Communication In Marriage
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is a divine union established by God from the beginning of creation, designed for companionship and mutual support, as seen in Genesis 2:18 and Mark 10:6. Effective communication within this sacred bond is vital, with Proverbs highlighting the wisdom of building one's household through careful and timely words. The believer's speech should reflect a heart aligned with God, seeking to honor Him as expressed in Psalms 19:14. Ultimately, the marriage relationship is to be preserved and protected, for what God has joined together must not be separated (Mark 10:9).
